overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines only because the leading semicolon disappears when aTable is omitted ("MODIFY RECORD ( aTable {; *} )" vs. "MODIFY RECORD ( * )"). Semantically this is one overload with both aTable and * independently optional.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table to use for data entry, or the default table if omitted.
If passed, the data-entry window is drawn without scroll bars or a size box.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Loads (if needed) and displays the current input form for the current record of aTable (or the default table), letting the user modify it interactively; does nothing if there is no current record.

constraints: The current record must have read-write access and must not be locked by another process/user.
Does not affect the current selection.
